items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with the band until the band really broke up, the first band. And then he had a quartet. Then when he went out and organized again, I couldn't make it.

ctx.x: So I says, "Okay." But anyway, they were all there and I had them up and they all come up and people all gave them a standing ovation. So I told them, I said, "Well, this is it. This is where we all started and these are the ones. Thank God they're still hanging in there, you know?" And there was a lady by the name of Miss Callie Frost . She had a daughter by the name of Jack Frost and Dorothy Frost. She really started it all. One Christmas -- she'd heard about the band. You know, we weren't -- playing little…
